title: I'm Waiting for You Lord
lyrics: As I lay upon my bed, Lord I remember days gone by
When I was young and healthy the gleam was in my eyes
Hair that was black as raven now has turned to grey
In this dark and dreary world Lord I don't want to stay
Walk with me through this valley
Help me Lord when I can't sleep
Hold my hand through the fight
Comfort me when I am weak
Let me feel your Holy Spirit when the Jordan I see
I'm waiting for you Lord guide my feet
I'm thinking of the blessings and all you've done for me
The places that I've been Lord and what my eyes have seen
This old world and all its beauty I know cannot compare
To what you have waiting for me when I get over there
